name: development_lead
description: The side to move has more pieces (knights and bishops) off their back rank than the opponent, indicating a development advantage.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'development_lead'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pieces (knights and bishops) off their back rank than the opponent, indicating a development advantage.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    # Define back rank squares for each color
    if stm == chess.WHITE:
        stm_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 0) for f in range(8)]
        opp_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 7) for f in range(8)]
    else:
        stm_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 7) for f in range(8)]
        opp_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 0) for f in range(8)]
    
    stm_developed = 0
    opp_developed = 0
    
    # Count developed minor pieces for stm
    stm_minors = list(board.pieces(chess.KNIGHT, stm)) + list(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm))
    for sq in stm_minors:
        if sq not in stm_back_rank:
            stm_developed += 1
            
    # Count developed minor pieces for opponent
    opp_minors = list(board.pieces(chess.KNIGHT, opp)) + list(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp))
    for sq in opp_minors:
        if sq not in opp_back_rank:
            opp_developed += 1
    
    # Only fire if stm has at least one developed piece
    if stm_developed == 0:
        return False
        
    # Require development lead of at least 1
    return stm_developed > opp_developed
